verdict.rationale: React docs confirm Suspense-driven streaming SSR and async server components that fetch data (react-docs-6, react-docs-7), which underpin resource-like data loading UIs, but this capability is explicitly framework-mediated (Next.js/React Router) rather than a documented built-in 'resource' primitive with concrete suspense-for-data-fetching examples in the pack. missing for 10: explicit mention of a `use()`/resource API for reading async data, first-party example of building a loading fallback with Suspense for fetched data, and independent/hands-on confirmation of this workflow.
